label: Thomas Aquinas, Summa theologiae I q.14 a.1…: Sense has aptitude to receive species without…
locator: I q.14 a.1 co.: Sensus autem cognoscitivus est, quia receptivus est specierum sine materia
interpretation: The source gives without-matter reception to sense before distinguishing intellect's greater separation from matter. The formal statement retains sensory receptivity and leaves intellectual aptitude separate; it supplies no identification of immateriality with intellectual power.
